text_blocks.snippet: The incubation period, or time between exposure to a virus and the onset of symptoms, for COVID-19 is typically 2-14 days. However, some people may develop symptoms sooner or later than this.

It's important to note that even if you don't have symptoms within the incubation period, you can still be contagious and spread the virus to others. Therefore, it's recommended to get tested if you've been exposed to someone with COVID-19, regardless of whether you have symptoms.
